app.title: Advanced Differential Gene Expression Dashboard
app.summary: A person uploads a CSV of differential expression results and maps its columns to gene name, log2 fold change and adjusted p-value, plus optional regulation, mean expression and raw p-value columns. They set a fold-change cutoff and an adjusted p-value cutoff with sliders, which marks each gene as significant, up or down, and they can narrow the table by a regulation label or look up named genes. Counts of significant, up- and downregulated genes update, and tabs show a volcano plot, a top-genes bar chart, histograms, an MA plot and a sortable table of significant genes. They download the significant genes as CSV or Excel, or the whole filtered table as CSV.

task.text: Pick out the significantly up- and downregulated genes from a differential expression results table by setting fold-change and p-value cutoffs, and export that gene list.

data.text: A results table from a differential expression test, one row per gene, with a fold change, an adjusted p-value and optional mean expression, raw p-value and regulation label.
data.item: a gene with its log2 fold change and adjusted p-value

stage.text: calling significant genes from differential expression results, after the statistical test and before enrichment or write-up

mechanism.text: An uploaded table is mapped to required fields and validated, then two threshold sliders recompute a significance flag that drives the metric cards, every chart tab, the significant-genes table and the downloads at once. The charts sit in tabs, with hover tooltips and zoom on the volcano plot and a sort control on the table.

field.text: differential gene expression analysis in transcriptomics

workflow.name: set significance cutoffs on a table of test results and export the items that pass

steps.here: a CSV is uploaded in the sidebar, with an optional preview of its first rows and its row and column counts

steps.step: map the table's columns to the fields the analysis needs
steps.here: dropdowns assign the gene, log2 fold change and adjusted p-value columns, with optional regulation, baseMean and raw p-value; columns over half missing are rejected, incomplete rows dropped and -log10(padj) computed

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: sliders for the |log2FC| cutoff and the adjusted p-value cutoff set a significant flag on every gene, split into up and down by the sign of the fold change

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: a dropdown keeps one regulation label, and a comma-separated gene search shows the matching rows
metric cards give total, significant, upregulated and downregulated genes with their percentages

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: tabs show a volcano plot coloured by regulation, a top-N up and down bar chart, fold-change and p-value histograms, an MA plot, and a table of significant genes sorted by p-value, fold change or name
download the significant genes as CSV or Excel, or all filtered genes as CSV

distinctive: significance is a joint rule on two cutoffs, an absolute log2 fold change and an adjusted p-value, and every view and export follows it
column mapping lets results from different differential expression tools be loaded without renaming columns, with validation of missing values
the MA plot of fold change against mean expression appears only when a mean-expression column is mapped
the top-genes chart takes half its genes from the strongest upregulated and half from the strongest downregulated

parts.title: Data upload

spans.first: # Sidebar for file upload and settings

parts.title: Column mapping
parts.summary: Assigns the table's columns to gene, fold change, adjusted p-value and optional fields, validates them and prepares the cleaned gene table.

parts.title: Significance thresholds and filters
parts.summary: Sets the fold-change and adjusted p-value cutoffs that flag genes as significant, and narrows by regulation label or a list of gene names.

parts.title: Summary statistics
parts.summary: Shows counts of total, significant, upregulated and downregulated genes with percentages.

parts.summary: Tabs that switch between the volcano plot, a top-genes bar chart, fold-change and p-value histograms, an MA plot and the significant-genes table.

parts.title: Volcano plot
parts.summary: Plots every gene by fold change against -log10 adjusted p-value, coloured up, down or not significant, with tooltips, zoom and a choice of plotting engine.

parts.title: Significant genes table
parts.summary: Lists the genes passing both cutoffs, sortable by adjusted p-value, fold change or name in either order.

parts.title: Export results
parts.summary: Downloads the significant genes as CSV or Excel, or the whole filtered table as CSV.
